    About this item

    • A comfortable, ambidextrous shape feels good in either hand, so you feel more comfortable as you work-even at the end of the day.
    • With 800 dpi sensitivity, you'll get precise cursor control so you can edit documents and navigate the Web more efficiently.
    • Side-to-side scrolling plus zoom lets you instantly zoom in or out and scroll horizontally and vertically. Perfect for working with spreadsheets and presentations.
    • Zero setup with flexible connectivity means you just plug it into your USB or PS/2 port-it works right out of the box.
    • This mouse is built by Logitech-the mouse experts. It comes with the quality and design we've built into more than a billion mice, more than any other manufacturer.

        Comfort in Hand

        Left-handed or right, you can work comfortably all day long with this ambidextrous mouse.

        Comfortable, Ambidextrous Design

        The comfortable, lower-profile shape feels good in either hand-even after a long day of work.

        Built by Logitech

        This mouse comes with the quality and design we’ve built into more than a billion mice, more than any other manufacturer.

        Smooth Operator

        You’re in control with smooth, responsive optical tracking that moves the cursor just where you want it.

        800 Dpi Optical Precision

        You’ll enjoy smooth, precise cursor control that lets you edit documents and navigate the Web more efficiently.

        Zero Setup

        It works right out of the box-you just plug it into your USB port and you’re ready for business.

          Logitech B100 Corded Wired USB Mouse ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
          Reviewed in India on 2 October 2025
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          I have been using the Logitech B100 for the past two years, and it has been an excellent purchase. The mouse is simple, reliable, and performs consistently well even after long-term use.

          The plug-and-play design makes it very convenient—just connect via USB, and it works instantly without any additional setup. The build quality is solid, and despite daily usage for two years, it still functions smoothly without any issues like lagging or double-click problems. The click response is crisp, and the scroll wheel works perfectly.

          Its ergonomic design is comfortable for long hours of work, and the lightweight feel makes it easy to use without strain. While it’s a very basic model without extra features, it delivers exactly what it promises: durability, precision, and reliability at a very affordable price.

          Overall, if you’re looking for a no-nonsense, long-lasting wired mouse for everyday use, the Logitech B100 is a great choice.

        • pallavi
          5 out of 5 stars
          Logitech B100 Wired USB Mouse (Black)
          Reviewed in India on 5 April 2026
          Verified Purchase
          Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
          Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

          Performance & Precision

          For a basic office mouse, the 800 DPI optical tracking is surprisingly smooth. I use it for everything from navigating dense spreadsheets to casual browsing, and the cursor never skips. It isn’t a "gaming" mouse, but for professional work, the precision is exactly where it needs to be.

          Build & Comfort

          The ambidextrous design is a huge plus—it feels natural in either hand. It’s lightweight but doesn't feel "cheap." The buttons have a satisfying click, and the scroll wheel provides just enough resistance to be accurate without being stiff.

          Setup & Compatibility

          It is truly plug-and-play. I plugged the 1.8m USB cable into my laptop, and it worked instantly without needing any drivers or software. The extra-long cord is great if your CPU is tucked under a desk.

          Value for Money

          What really sets this apart is the 3-year warranty. In a market full of budget mice that break after a few months, knowing Logitech backs this for three years makes it an easy choice.
